notes: Partition verified: all 22 source and 22 target ids are covered exactly once across 21 units (s013+s014 fused), and every head is a member of its array.

The second `אֵת` (s021) is read as the appositional marker rendered *even* under rule 16's second family, while the first (s011) is the ordinary unrepresented marker; the competing reading would mark both unrepresented and call *even* `added`, but nothing else in the clause licenses that word.

`לְפָנֶיךָ` is one rule 30 unit (*before*) headed on `פָּנֶה`, with the suffix taking *thee* separately; the ethical dative of `קַח־לְךָ` is unrepresented under rule 40 because the ASV writes the bare indirect object *take thee*, in contrast with EZK.4.3 and EZK.4.9 where it writes *unto thee*.
